'''R3-M2''' was an [[R3-series astromech droid|R3-series]] [[astromech droid]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

==Behind the scenes==
R3-M2 first appeared in the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" />
